'''Karu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Karu appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Starfighter & PvP Decoration vendor.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
